fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide, low arc 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Bring In the Sheaves
fusions.desc: A reaping chop on an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow. The health threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Reaped Vigour
fusions.desc: Each critical hit you land restores 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
